SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, b.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, cp.CATEGORY_PATH AS categoryName, TO_NUMBER(p.PRICE) AS price, TO_NUMBER(p.SALE_PRICE) AS salePrice, NVL(os.STOCK_QTY, 0) AS stockQty, p.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, f.FILE_URL AS thumbnailUrl, p.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_PRODUCT p JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = p.BIZ_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CATEGORY_ID, SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(CATEGORY_NAME, ' > '), 4) AS CATEGORY_PATH FROM TB_PRODUCT_CATEGORY WHERE DEPTH >= 2 START WITH DEPTH = 2 CONNECT BY PRIOR CATEGORY_ID = PARENT_ID ) cp ON cp.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID, SUM(STOCK_QTY) AS STOCK_QTY FROM TB_PRODUCT_OPTION GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ) os ON os.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REF_ID, FILE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY REF_ID ORDER BY FILE_ID) AS RN FROM TB_FILE WHERE REF_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' ) f ON f.REF_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND f.RN = 1 WHERE ORDER BY p.PRODUCT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRODUCT p JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = p.BIZ_NO WHERE

SELECT o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, NVL(o.ORDER_GROUP_NO, o.ORDER_NO) AS orderGroupNo, o.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, b.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, NVL(m.NICKNAME, m.MEMBER_NAME) AS buyerName, (SELECT oi.PRODUCT_NAME FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS firstProductName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID) AS itemCount, o.PAY_AMOUNT AS payAmount, p.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.ORDER_DATE AS orderDate FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = o.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = o.BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE ORDER BY o.ORDER_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = o.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = o.BIZ_NO WHERE

SELECT o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, NVL(o.ORDER_GROUP_NO, o.ORDER_NO) AS orderGroupNo, o.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, b.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, NVL(m.NICKNAME, m.MEMBER_NAME) AS buyerName, (SELECT oi.PRODUCT_NAME FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS firstProductName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID) AS itemCount, o.PAY_AMOUNT AS payAmount, p.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.ORDER_DATE AS orderDate FROM TB_ORDER o JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = o.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_BUSINESS b ON b.BIZ_NO = o.BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
